scenarios.name: enters-may-attach-equipment-to-a-creature
scenarios.why: The optional enters trigger may attach a target Equipment you control to a target creature you control; the chosen Equipment ends up attached, so the Bears are 4/2.

scenarios.name: equipment-cannot-attach-to-opponents-creature
scenarios.why: Both targets must be permanents you control (an Equipment you control and a creature you control); with only an opponent's creature available the trigger has no legal creature target and attaches nothing.
